orientation: N=up E=right S=down W=left in native unrotated art. GrassSide_N means grass on north; WaterSide_N means water on north. Notch directions identify the intruding named material. Corner directions identify occupied grass corner. Connections sample edge midpoints; corners sample corner pixels.
height_semantics: FrontFace projects down-screen (S); no absolute gameplay height is inferred. Shadow direction names are assembly positions. Preserve cell rotations/flips.
scope: Regular light-green sheets used in Hometown, plus matching static stone-bank water. No other biome or farmland art.
behavior_contract: Grass_ and Water_Middle name prefixes are retained for HabitatAnimal.IsSafe. Animation arrays, order, speed, rules and collider settings are untouched.
